question: compute/cirrus-runners has no counterpart in ci-cd-runners and no relation to the dead Cirrus CI records; is a separate record enough, or should a sibling relation kind exist for two products of one vendor?
why: The vendor announcement treats Cirrus Runners (a $150 a month paid GitHub Actions runner service, closed to new customers) and Cirrus CI (shut down) as separate products, so the duplicate kinds do not apply.
